# telnyx_number_block_orders (Data Source)

Lists number block orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_number_block_order`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at_gt` (String) Filter number block orders later than this value.
- `filter_created_at_lt` (String) Filter number block orders earlier than this value.
- `filter_phone_numbers_starting_number` (String) Filter number block orders having these phone numbers.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter number block orders by status.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `number_block_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_block_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--number_block_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `number_block_orders`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (String) Identifies the connection associated to all numbers in the phone number block.
- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string denoting when the number order was created.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string for customer look ups.
- `id` (String)
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Identifies the messaging profile associated to all numbers in the phone number block.
- `phone_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers in the number order.
- `range` (Number) The phone number range included in the block.
- `record_type` (String)
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) True if all requirements are met for every phone number, false otherwise.
- `starting_number` (String) Starting phone number block
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string for when the number order was updated.
